_description: ISCA'27 v3 ablation: M1 + M2. M1 (network interface): merge = requester in-flight table merge (-t18-req-merge, dedup owner m1) + owner merge table (-t18-owner-merge); pack = same-page bitmap batching + prefetch piggyback (old m2: -remote-data-path-batching-enable, -remote-filter-prefetch-enable); allocation = credit policy rtt over the W = 64 slots; M2 (network): in-mesh multicast of merged owner responses (-t18-owner-multicast); no M3: requester L2 neither probed nor filled (-remote-data-path-l2-enable=false). Both tables keep 64 entries (t18-window 64, table = 2W = 128 slots, -t18-req-entries/-t18-owner-entries unset). Old m2 filter dedup off (-remote-data-path-dedup-enable=false). Extends mi200.json (unchanged); -magic-memory-copy comes from mi200.json/hpca.json. P16 config #3.
